prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence remains thin for single-test categories: adoption redesigns, adoption wait_info, finish layout/new_screen/redesign, home new_flow, and sign-in reordering.
Home wait_info changes are helpful, supported by 2 winning tests out of 4.
Choose_path redesigns (2 tests) and choose_path copy updates (2 tests) showed no positive effect, ranging from no effect to worse.
Adoption hints (3 tests), home redesigns (2 tests), sign-in copy updates (2 tests), and sign-in incentives (2 tests) showed no clear effect.
Finish hints (2 tests) and sign-in notifications (2 tests) showed no clear effect or performed worse.
Predictions were consistently too low for winning changes and too high for changes that had no clear effect or performed worse.

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Pet Animation Preview Display: Displays a live animated preview of pet idle actions on the waiting screen while background generation finishes. (why: The waiting step has a long mean duration (2336s). Lessons learned show home wait_info changes are effective (2 out of 4 tested were winners).)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Interaction Controls Video Showcase: Inserts a dedicated onboarding end screen with short video clips showing how to drag, hide, summon, and talk to the pet on desktop. (why: Support received 3 emails from users confused about how to interact with, hide, or control their pet after setup.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Visibility Status Progress Checklist: Adds a detailed system readiness checklist to the waiting screen verifying overlay display, graphics rendering, and window permissions. (why: Support logged 3 issues where pets failed to render on desktop, and home wait_info components have shown strong test performance.)
3: [choose_path, hint] Choose Path Pet Archetype Clarification Hint: Adds a hint on the choose_path screen explaining that chosen pet paths can be customized or switched anytime after setup. (why: Choose_path has a high mean time (514s) relative to its median (8s), suggesting decision hesitation among stuck users.)
4: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Render Preview Confirmation Screen: Inserts a render confirmation screen after photo upload, allowing users to verify pet visual feature extraction before adoption. (why: 3 support emails reported that custom pet creation failed or resulted in wrong visual outputs.)
5: [home, notification] Background Pet Readiness Audio Chime Alert: Adds an option on the waiting screen to sound an audio chime when the desktop pet generation finishes. (why: The waiting screen mean time is 2336s (approx 38 minutes), showing users minimize the app while waiting and miss completion.)
